### 1. Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets

* **Applicability:** Applies to **Tax Years 2025 and 2026**. Under Act 46 (SLH 2024), new brackets took effect for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. The rate schedules remain identical for 2025 and 2026 (the next statutory bracket adjustments take effect in 2027).
* **Brackets and Rates (HRS § 235-51):**

  **Schedule I: Single and Married Filing Separately**
  * Not over $9,600: 1.40% of taxable income
  * Over $9,600 but not over $14,400: $134 + 3.20% of excess over $9,600
  * Over $14,400 but not over $19,200: $288 + 5.50% of excess over $14,400
  * Over $19,200 but not over $24,000: $552 + 6.40% of excess over $19,200
  * Over $24,000 but not over $36,000: $859 + 6.80% of excess over $24,000
  * Over $36,000 but not over $48,000: $1,675 + 7.20% of excess over $36,000
  * Over $48,000 but not over $125,000: $2,539 + 7.60% of excess over $48,000
  * Over $125,000 but not over $175,000: $8,391 + 7.90% of excess over $125,000
  * Over $175,000 but not over $225,000: $12,341 + 8.25% of excess over $175,000
  * Over $225,000 but not over $275,000: $16,466 + 9.00% of excess over $225,000
  * Over $275,000 but not over $325,000: $20,966 + 10.00% of excess over $275,000
  * Over $325,000: $25,966 + 11.00% of excess over $325,000

  **Schedule II: Married Filing Jointly and Surviving Spouses**
  * Not over $19,200: 1.40% of taxable income
  * Over $19,200 but not over $28,800: $269 + 3.20% of excess over $19,200
  * Over $28,800 but not over $38,400: $576 + 5.50% of excess over $28,800
  * Over $38,400 but not over $48,000: $1,104 + 6.40% of excess over $38,400
  * Over $48,000 but not over $72,000: $1,718 + 6.80% of excess over $48,000
  * Over $72,000 but not over $96,000: $3,350 + 7.20% of excess over $72,000
  * Over $96,000 but not over $250,000: $5,078 + 7.60% of excess over $96,000
  * Over $250,000 but not over $350,000: $16,782 + 7.90% of excess over $250,000
  * Over $350,000 but not over $450,000: $24,682 + 8.25% of excess over $350,000
  * Over $450,000 but not over $550,000: $32,932 + 9.00% of excess over $450,000
  * Over $550,000 but not over $650,000: $41,932 + 10.00% of excess over $550,000
  * Over $650,000: $51,932 + 11.00% of excess over $650,000

  **Schedule III: Head of Household**
  * Not over $14,400: 1.40% of taxable income
  * Over $14,400 but not over $21,600: $202 + 3.20% of excess over $14,400
  * Over $21,600 but not over $28,800: $432 + 5.50% of excess over $21,600
  * Over $28,800 but not over $36,000: $828 + 6.40% of excess over $28,800
  * Over $36,000 but not over $54,000: $1,289 + 6.80% of excess over $36,000
  * Over $54,000 but not over $72,000: $2,513 + 7.20% of excess over $54,000
  * Over $72,000 but not over $187,500: $3,809 + 7.60% of excess over $72,000
  * Over $187,500 but not over $262,500: $12,587 + 7.90% of excess over $187,500
  * Over $262,500 but not over $337,500: $18,512 + 8.25% of excess over $262,500
  * Over $337,500 but not over $412,500: $24,699 + 9.00% of excess over $337,500
  * Over $412,500 but not over $487,500: $31,449 + 10.00% of excess over $412,500
  * Over $487,500: $38,949 + 11.00% of excess over $487,500
* **Official URLs:**  
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/tax-rate-schedules-for-taxable-years-beginning-after-december-31-2024/
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/news-alert/tax-year-information-2025/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0235/HRS_0235-0051.htm

---

### 2. Corporate Income Tax, Franchise Tax, and Minimum Tax

* **Applicability:** Applies unchanged to both **Tax Year 2025 and Tax Year 2026**.
* **Corporate Income Tax Rates (HRS § 235-71):**
  * Taxable income up to $25,000: **4.4%**
  * Taxable income over $25,000 but not over $100,000: **5.4%**
  * Taxable income over $100,000: **6.4%**
  * Capital gains alternative tax (HRS § 235-71.5): **4.0%**
* **Corporate Minimum Tax:** **Not found** (Hawaii does not levy a minimum corporate income tax under HRS Chapter 235).
* **Franchise Tax on Financial Institutions (HRS § 241-4):**
  * Imposed on banks and other financial corporations in lieu of corporate income tax at a rate of **7.92%** of entire net income from all sources (with an alternative capital gains rate of 4.0%).
* **Official URLs:**  
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0235/HRS_0235-0071.htm
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0235/HRS_0235-0071_0005.htm
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0241/HRS_0241-0004.htm

---

### 3. Sales and Use Tax Rates and Local Surcharges

* **Applicability:** Applies unchanged to both **Tax Year 2025 and Tax Year 2026**.
* **Sales Tax:** Hawaii has **no general sales tax**; instead, it levies a **General Excise Tax (GET)** on gross business receipts and a complementary **Use Tax**.
* **State Base Rates:**
  * **Retail Sales & Services (GET & Use Tax):** **4.0%**
  * **Wholesaling / Manufacturing / Producing:** **0.50%**
  * **Insurance Commissions:** **0.15%**
  * **Use Tax on imports for resale at wholesale:** **0.50%**
* **Local County Surcharges:**
  * All four counties (City and County of Honolulu, Kauai County, Hawaii County, and Maui County) impose an authorized **0.5%** county surcharge on transactions subject to the 4.0% state rate.
  * Total combined GET / Use Tax rate on retail goods and services in all four counties: **4.5%** (maximum allowable visible pass-on rate to customers is **4.7120%**).
  * The county surcharge does not apply to wholesale activities (0.50%) or insurance commissions (0.15%).
* **Official URLs:**  
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/genexc/
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/genexc/county-surcharge/

---

### 4. Gross Receipts, Franchise, Margin, or Other Notable Business Taxes

* **Applicability:** Applies to **Tax Year 2025 and Tax Year 2026**.
* **General Excise Tax (GET) (HRS Chapter 237):** A gross receipts / privilege tax levied directly on the business (not the consumer) on gross receipts/income from virtually all business activity conducted in the state (retail/services at 4.0% + 0.5% county surcharge; wholesale/producing at 0.50%; insurance commissions at 0.15%).
* **Franchise Tax (HRS Chapter 241):** Assessed against banks and financial corporations at **7.92%** of net income.
* **Pass-Through Entity (PTE) Elective Tax (HRS § 235-51.5):** Elective entity-level income tax for partnerships and S corporations at a rate of **9%** (enacted under Act 50, SLH 2023, as amended by SB 2725 / Act 58, SLH 2025).
* **Transient Accommodations Tax (TAT) (HRS Chapter 237D):** State gross rental income tax levied on transient accommodations at **10.25%**, plus county transient accommodations surcharges of up to **3.0%**.
* **Public Service Company Tax (HRS Chapter 239):** Levied on public utility companies on gross income in lieu of the general excise tax.
* **Margin Tax:** **Not found** (Hawaii does not impose a Texas-style margin tax).
* **Official URLs:**  
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/genexc/
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/pte/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0237/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/Vol04_Ch0201-0257/HRS0241/

### 1. Individual Return Due Dates & Extension Rules (Calendar-Year Filers)

* **Due Date:**
  * **Tax Year 2025:** April 20, 2026.
  * **Tax Year 2026:** April 20, 2027 (calendar-year individual income tax returns are due annually on April 20).
* **Extension Rules:**
  * Hawaii grants an automatic 6-month extension (through October 20) to file Form N-11 or Form N-15. 
  * **Form Required:** No form is required to request the extension. Federal extension forms (such as Form 4868) are not accepted.
  * **Conditions:** The extension is granted automatically if:
    1. The taxpayer is due a refund, or
    2. The taxpayer pays the "properly estimated tax liability" on or before April 20.
  * **"Properly Estimated Tax Liability":** Requires a bona fide and reasonable attempt to gather all information and payment of at least 90% of the total tax liability shown on the return.
  * **Payment Method:** Payments can be submitted electronically via Hawaii Tax Online (hitax.hawaii.gov) or by mail with Form N-200V (*Individual Income Tax Payment Voucher*).
* **Applicability:** Applies to both Tax Years 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/faqs/

---

### 2. Corporate and Pass-Through Return Due Dates & Extension Rules

* **Due Dates:**
  * **C Corporations (Form N-30), S Corporations (Form N-35), and Partnerships (Form N-20):** Due on or before the 20th day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year (April 20 for calendar-year filers; e.g., April 20, 2026, for TY 2025 and April 20, 2027, for TY 2026).
* **Extension Rules:**
  * An automatic 6-month extension to file is granted pursuant to Hawaii Administrative Rules (HAR) § 18-235-98.
  * **Form Required:** No separate application form is required. To qualify, the entity must pay its properly estimated tax liability on or before the original due date (April 20 for calendar filers). 
  * **Payment Method:** Payments may be made via Hawaii Tax Online or with Form N-201V (*Business Income Tax Payment Voucher*).
* **Applicability:** Applies to both Tax Years 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URLs:**
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/faqs/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/

---

### 3. Elective Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET)

* **Existence:** Yes. Enacted under Act 50 (SLH 2023), amended under Act 50 (SLH 2024) and Act 58 (SLH 2025); codified at HRS § 235-51.5.
* **Rate:** **9%** for taxable years 2024 and forward (including Tax Years 2025 and 2026). (Previously 11% for TY 2023).
* **Tax Base:** Sum of all qualified members' distributive shares and guaranteed payments multiplied by 9%. A "qualified member" must be an individual, trust, or estate.
* **How to Elect:** The entity (partnership or S corporation) makes the annual election by submitting:
  1. **Form N-362E** (*Pass-Through Entity Tax Election*), signed by each member or an authorized officer/manager/member attesting under penalty of perjury.
  2. **Schedule PTE** (*Pass-Through Entity Tax Calculation*), filed concurrently with Form N-20 or Form N-35.
* **When to Elect:** Annually. Form N-362E must be filed by the 20th day of the 4th month following the close of the taxable year, or by the 20th day of the 10th month if an automatic 6-month extension is obtained.
* **2025/2026 Legislative Note:** Act 58 (SLH 2025) requires all qualified members claiming the PTE credit to add back their share of taxes paid by the electing PTE to their Hawaii taxable income for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024 (applies to TY 2025 and TY 2026).
* **Official URLs:**
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/

---

### 4. Composite or Group Nonresident Returns for Pass-Through Entities

* **S Corporations:** Under HRS § 235-128(b), the Department is authorized to permit S corporations to file composite returns and make composite payments on behalf of nonresident shareholders. 
* **Partnerships:** **Not found** on the Hawaii Department of Taxation website or Hawaii Revised Statutes (Hawaii provides nonresident partner withholding under Act 232 / HRS § 235-68 instead of a partnership composite return).
* **Department Administration:** The Department does not provide a dedicated composite return form on its active forms listing. Nonresident owners satisfy filing through entity-level PTE taxation, individual Form N-15 filings, nonresident shareholder agreements (Form N-35 Schedule NS), or mandatory nonresident withholding (Form N-4 / Form N-4P).
* **Applicability:** Applies to both Tax Years 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URLs:**
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/forms/

---

### 5. Estimated Tax Requirements & Pass-Through Nonresident Withholding

* **Estimated Tax Requirements:**
  * **Requirement & Threshold:** Individuals, corporations (including S corporations), estates, and trusts must pay estimated taxes if the liability (after subtracting withholding and credits) is **$500 or more** (HRS § 235-97(a)).
  * **Payment Due Dates (Calendar Filers):** 4 quarterly installments due on **April 20, June 20, September 20, and January 20** (January 20 of following year) (HRS § 235-97(a)(2)).
  * **Safe Harbor:** Under HAR § 18-235-97(c), penalties are avoided if payments equal at least 60% of the current year tax or 100% of the prior year tax.
  * **Electing Pass-Through Entities:** Beginning in tax year 2024 and continuing through 2025 and 2026, electing PTEs are required to make estimated payments of PTE tax and are subject to underpayment penalties under HRS § 235-97(f).
* **Nonresident Withholding for Pass-Through Entities:**
  * **Partnerships:** Required under Act 232 (SLH 2019) and TIR 2025-03 to withhold tax on a nonresident partner’s distributive share of Hawaii income at the highest marginal rate under HRS § 235-51. Reported on Form N-20 Schedule NP and Form N-4P.
  * **S Corporations:** Must obtain and file an agreement from each nonresident shareholder on Form N-35 Schedule NS promising to file and pay Hawaii tax. If no agreement is filed, the S corporation must withhold/pay tax at the highest marginal rate under HRS § 235-51 using Form N-4 (HRS § 235-128(c)).
  * **PTET Exception:** If a partnership or S corporation elects and pays the entity-level PTE tax, the payment satisfies the nonresident withholding requirement for qualified nonresident members.
* **Applicability:** Applies to both Tax Years 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URLs:**
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/
  * https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/

---

### 6. Main Individual, Corporate, and Pass-Through Return Forms

* **Individual Income Tax:**
  * **Form N-11:** *Individual Income Tax Return (Resident)*
  * **Form N-15:** *Individual Income Tax Return (Nonresident and Part-Year Resident)*
  * **Form N-200V:** *Individual Income Tax Payment Voucher*
  * **Form N-210:** *Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals, Estates and Trusts*
* **Corporate Income Tax:**
  * **Form N-30:** *Corporation Income Tax Return*
  * **Form N-201V:** *Business Income Tax Payment Voucher*
  * **Form N-220:** *Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporations and S Corporations*
* **Pass-Through Entities:**
  * **Form N-20:** *Partnership Tax Return*
  * **Schedule K-1 (Form N-20):** *Partner's Share of Income, Credits, Deductions, etc.*
  * **Schedule NP (Form N-20):** *Allocation of Withholding Payment to Nonresident Partners*
  * **Form N-4P:** *Statement of Withholding for a Nonresident Partner of a Partnership*
  * **Form N-35:** *S Corporation Income Tax Return*
  * **Schedule K-1 (Form N-35):** *Shareholder's Share of Income, Credits, Deductions, etc.*
  * **Schedule NS (Form N-35):** *Hawaii S Corporation Agreement of Nonresident Shareholder*
  * **Form N-4:** *Statement of Withholding for a Nonresident Shareholder of an S Corporation*
  * **Form N-362E:** *Pass-Through Entity Tax Election*
  * **Schedule PTE:** *Pass-Through Entity Tax Calculation*
  * **Form N-362:** *Pass-Through Entity Tax Credit* (claimed by members)
* **Applicability:** Applies to both Tax Years 2025 and 2026.
* **Official URL:**
  * https://tax.hawaii.gov/forms/
